# Official C2PA interoperability fixture

`adobe-20220124-CA.jpg` is copied unchanged from the C2PA public test files:

- Source repository: https://github.com/c2pa-org/public-testfiles
- Source file: https://github.com/c2pa-org/public-testfiles/blob/main/legacy/1.4/image/jpeg/adobe-20220124-CA.jpg
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0), as declared by the source repository.

This is an official interoperability fixture containing C2PA data. It is not
described here as a current Photoshop Generative AI sample. Unit tests use it
to exercise the custom JPEG container parser and byte-range cleaner. Actual
`@contentauth/c2pa-web` validation remains a browser/WASM integration test.
